title: ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories
abstract: arXiv:2610.38255v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) layers replace the linear fast-weight memory of modern recurrent architectures with a small neural network trained online by gradient descent. This nonlinear memory is more expressive than the linear memories of Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2, but is difficult to parallelize: existing implementations such as TTT-MLP rely on sequential, block-wise weight updates that run several times slower than chunkwise-parallel linear recurrences. Their block-wise execution only approximates the token-by-token online recurrence, whereas linear recurrences admit an exact chunkwise-parallel evaluation. We introduce ParaTTT (PTTT), an algorithm for parallelizing arbitrarily deep nonlinear memories by iteratively refining estimates of the inner-loop gradient trajectory. translated_title: ParaTTT：深度记忆的测试时训练层并行化
translated_abstract: 测试时训练层用一个小型神经网络替代现代循环架构中的线性快速权重记忆，该神经网络通过梯度下降在线训练。这种非线性记忆比 Gated DeltaNet 和 Mamba-2 的线性记忆更具表现力，但难以并行化：现有实现（如 TTT-MLP）依赖于顺序的、按块进行的权重更新，其运行速度比分块并行的线性递归慢数倍。而且它们的按块执行只能近似逐 token 的在线递归，而线性递归则可以实现精确的分块并行求值。我们提出 ParaTTT（PTTT），这是一种通过迭代细化内循环梯度轨迹估计来并行化任意深度非线性记忆的算法。每次细化包含三个分块并行的过程：一个评估所得特征轨迹的前向过程，一个精确的门控增量规则过程……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 ParaTTT 算法，通过迭代细化内循环梯度轨迹的估计，将任意深度的非线性测试时训练记忆实现分块精确并行化，克服了现有顺序块更新实现速度慢且只能近似的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: ParaTTT parallelizes arbitrarily deep nonlinear test-time training memories by iteratively refining estimates of the inner-loop gradient trajectory, enabling exact chunkwise-parallel computation that overcomes the slow sequential block-wise updates of existing implementations.
